newsitems.title: New "Disable Counter" Feature & Related Notes
newsitems.author: Yinengjie
newsitems.contents: Feature UpdateWe've added a \ feature. You can now turn off the keyboard/mouse counter in the settings.You can re-enable it at any time after disabling.When disabled, your character will no longer sync with your keystrokes.We want to emphasize: whether enabled or disabled, in every version, we never record what you type — the counter simply increments by 1. The demo version also has no network activity beyond Steam and the official Unity SDK.We've improved the onboarding flow: the counter feature will only be enabled after you explicitly agree to start counting.Regarding the "Uninstall Prompt After Uninstalling" IssueWe released an update and fixed this issue yesterday at 7 AM Pacific Time (UTC-7). If you uninstalled the game before then, the installation prompt may still appear after uninstalling. In this case, the only workarounds are to reinstall the game once, or manually remove the startup entry. We know this is inconvenient, but there's nothing we can do to fix it on our end once the game has been uninstalled. This was our technical mistake, and we sincerely apologize to everyone affected — especially those who have already uninstalled the game.If possible, we'd also appreciate it if players who are aware of this issue could help pass the message along to others experiencing it. Thank you so much!Our announcement yesterday mentioned the workaround for uninstalled players, but the image on Steam wasn't very clear, so we'll mention it again: open Task Manager, find the cmd.exe startup entry, and disable it (if there are multiple entries with the same name, you can identify the correct one by its command line, as shown in the image).Regarding Claims That Counting Continues After Closing the GameWe've received reports from players that the counter still counts after the game is closed, but despite repeated testing and investigation on our end, we haven't been able to reproduce it. Special thanks to player 『Ｔｏｍｏｋｕｓｈ』 for reporting this and pointing out that it might be caused by Steam Cloud saves (which ensure your character appears on different devices), which also sync the counter. We tested this scenario, and the count does indeed jump on one device — but this isn't counting while the game is "closed," since the game isn't actually closed; it's simply running on another device.We still can't confirm whether this is the cause. But if you've experienced this issue and are certain it's not due to multiple devices, please let us know. Thank you!A Word from the DevelopersWe've only had the demo live for less than a week, and there are still many areas where we fall short. But thanks to everyone's support and word of mouth, we've received an incredible amount of attention — which means every hour a problem persists affects that many more people. We're truly grateful to every player who has reported issues, and we're learning how to receive and act on this feedback.Most importantly, what we've received most of all is encouragement and appreciation from players all over the world — your tolerance, kindness, and support despite all our issues means so much. Please believe us when we say: no one cherishes this game more than our team does, and no one wants more than us to create a desktop companion you can trust. Thank you all, sincerely!

newsitems.title: "Character House"— First Update Announcement (With Easter Eggs)
newsitems.author: Yinengjie
newsitems.contents: \New Character Reset Feature If your character accidentally falls off the screen, you can now bring them back with a single click from the taskbar. Sorry for letting your character get locked in the little black room (＞人＜；).Taskbar Quick Pin Toggle You can now quickly turn "Always on Top" on and off from the taskbar. If a character gets in the way during an immersive gaming session, switch it with one click — no more digging through the settings.New Frame Rate Selection (30/60/unlimited) to reduce the load on your computer.Fixed an issue on Windows where uninstalling the game with auto-start enabled would trigger an installation prompt.For players who still have the game installed: this update fixes the issue automatically—no action required.For players who have already uninstalled: you can reinstall the game once and then uninstall it, or disable the startup entry via Task Manager.We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience this has caused\Less than a week after launch, we've already received feedback far beyond what we expected. Really, truly, thank you all for your support — we've read every single comment and every suggestion.A quick update from us: this is our team's very first game. The team has fewer than 5 people, and we didn't even have time to find a publisher — we're running all our social media channels ourselves. Right now the feedback on every platform has completely "flooded" us, so we may not be able to reply to each one in the short term. We're truly sorry, and we humbly ask for your understanding. We know that behind every piece of feedback lies your support and expectations. We'll do our best to solve everyone's problems — please just give us a little time.\Here are a few Easter eggs we'd like to share (features we added that few people have discovered):Click the palette in the top-right corner of the color card to save your frequently used colors;The color values below the color card support manual input — a dream for precision color pickers;Once your character learns the "Shy" action, pet them and they'll get all shy;After mastering "Anger," if you type too fast in typing mode, your character will get very worked up;Drag two characters together and they'll look at each other;Make good use of typing mode to bring multiple characters back into place at once, or quickly "shoo" them to the sides of your desktop;Right-click a character and drag — they'll obediently follow your mouse.\Feedback: advice@yinengjie.ccBusiness inquiries: corp@yinengjie.ccthread：https://www.threads.com/@characterhouse_steamx：https://x.com/CharacterHouse1discord：https://discord.gg/6Dp9tBREzLastly, we hope you enjoy the company of your "Desktop Companion," and thank you for continuing to "keep us company"~
